reason: The Opt-in Modules list gains the AI Chat module's install commands (add ai-chat-routes for browser-direct, add ai-chat-proxy-routes for the server proxy), pointing to add-ai-chat.

The Workflow Button section says `CollectionForm` renders the `workflow_state` field as the button itself, that the button needs no `WorkflowProvider` and has no confirmation dialog, and drops the `canCompare` prop, which Buildpad UI 3.11 does not have.
